title: Analyzing Cognitive Differences Among Large Language Models through the Lens of Social Worldview
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study. The research centers on socio-cognitive worldviews like Hierarchy, Egalitarianism, Individualism, and Fatalism.

measurement_description: The benchmark does not measure faith or religion. It evaluates socio-cognitive attitudes based on Cultural Theory, focusing on four worldviews: Hierarchy, Egalitarianism, Individualism, and Fatalism. Religion is only mentioned in the related work section as a type of bias studied by other researchers.
